scenarios.name: One Byzantine Validator Failure
scenarios.description: Consensus continues uninterrupted when 1 of 4 nodes fails (75% power >= 66.7% quorum).

scenarios.name: Conflicting Proposals (Equivocation Detection)
scenarios.description: Conflicting block proposals for the same height/round are detected and rejected by VotePool.

scenarios.name: Double Signing Rejection
scenarios.description: Validator double-signing precommits for distinct blocks at same height is rejected.

scenarios.name: Invalid Ed25519 Signature Rejection
scenarios.description: Forged or bit-flipped Ed25519 signatures are strictly rejected by VerifyVote / VerifyCommitCertificate.

scenarios.name: Forged Commit Certificate Rejection
scenarios.description: Blocks without authentic >2/3 quorum commit certificates cannot be finalized or committed.

scenarios.name: Insufficient Voting Power Safety Halt
scenarios.description: When voting power drops to 50% (<= 66.7%), consensus safely halts without producing empty or split blocks.

scenarios.name: Network Partition Healing & Quorum Restoration
scenarios.description: Partition healing restores active power to 100%, and BFT consensus automatically resumes.

scenarios.name: Delayed and Reordered Message Handling
scenarios.description: Asynchronous delayed votes and future round votes are buffered or discarded safely.

scenarios.name: Validator Restart and Fast-Sync Recovery
scenarios.description: All 4 nodes synchronized in lockstep with matching block height and AppHash after restart.

scenarios.name: Conflicting Commits Rejection
scenarios.description: CommitCertificate height/hash must strictly match block data; mismatched commits fail closed.

scenarios.name: Validator-Set Binding & Unknown Validator Rejection
scenarios.description: Signatures from identities not registered in canonical genesis validator set are rejected.

scenarios.name: Replay Attack Rejection
scenarios.description: Canonical vote serialization binds ChainID, Step, Height, Round, and Hash, preventing replay.

scenarios.name: Malicious Synchronization Response Rejection
scenarios.description: Blocks without cryptographically verified commit certificates are rejected during fast-sync.

scenarios.name: Application State Divergence & Financial Invariant
scenarios.description: Total bank supply, minted, burned, and AppHash are identical across all 4 nodes (Delta = 0).
